title: Awesome tour!!!! ♡
text: Definitely a highlight on our Barcelona trip! We didn't realize that it would be completely private! ( Just my husband, myself, and our tour guide, Mateo.) He was our favorite guide of all the various activities we did on our Spain trip! He was extremely knowledgeable which we very much appreciate, and his passion for history was very apparent. The bullet train to Girona was as easy as a train ride could be, we arrived in about 35 minutes!   Everything we saw was so beautiful and full of history. title: Game of Thrones - Best Girona Tour
text: We had a fantastic day in Girona. Our guide, Lucas was wonderful, knowledgeable and very accommodating. He took us to all the locations where Game of Thrones was filmed.  Highly recommend. My only issue was that the tour operator gave us the wrong time and address to meet him. But once he found us it was wonderful.
